blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: FCI plays a crucial role in strengthening national food security.
It supports farmers by assuring income through crop procurement.
It regulates market availability to prevent hoarding and black marketing.
It serves as the backbone for distributing food grains under essential welfare schemes.
FCI's dual role: Ensuring remunerative prices for farmers while maintaining buffer stocks for national food security.
Market intervention function: Curbing black marketing and price volatility during grain shortages.
Implementation vector: FCI food grains form the supply core for government welfare initiatives like PDS.
